overall_goal: Finish preparing the drink, clear the workspace, and clean the kitchen counter and hob.

goals.rationale: The person puts away the freezer bag of sugar into the cupboard and throws the empty sugar bag into the bin.

goals.description: Fill the saucepan with water and stir.
goals.rationale: The person uses a beaker to fetch water from the sink, pours it into the saucepan on the hob, stirs the contents, and turns on the hob.

goals.description: Move hot saucepans off the hob to cool.
goals.rationale: The person removes the saucepans of hibiscus drink and oil from the hob, retrieves a cooling rack, and places the saucepan of oil on it.

goals.description: Clear the hob and counter of items and pan supports.
goals.rationale: The person moves a plastic bottle, removes the pan supports from the hob, and transfers bowls and a spoon to the sink and counter to prepare for cleaning.

goals.description: Discard leftover flour and place empty bowls in the sink.
goals.rationale: The person inspects leftover flour, discards paper packaging, pours the flour into the food bin, and places the empty bowl in the sink.

goals.description: Wipe the counter surface with a rag.
goals.rationale: The person uses a rag to wipe down the counter surface, picking up discarded flour and dusting it into the sink.

goals.description: Wash the dirty rag and place it in the washing basket.
goals.rationale: The person scrubs the rag under the running tap to remove stains, squeezes out excess water, and tosses it into the washing pile.

goals.description: Wet a sponge and wipe the counter surface.
goals.rationale: The person wets a sponge at the sink and uses it to clean the counter surface, lifting items to clean underneath them.

goals.description: Wipe the counter and items with a rag.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a rag to wipe the counter surface again, moving items like the saucepan, cooling rack, and washing up liquid bottle to clean thoroughly.

goals.description: Clean the hob with a sponge and wash hands.
goals.rationale: The person uses the sponge to clean the hob, collects and discards food particles in the sink, rinses the sponge, and finally washes their hands.
